doc.title: Jon Hendricks interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Syllabus and wrapping up
summary: Talk of a syllabus, the waiting driver and a possible part three.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Well I have to put this in the form of a syllabus, whatever that is.
I have no doubt you’ll manage. Well I hate to say this, your driver is waiting and —
Serves him right. If I don’t wear out my welcome I may come back and say Jon, how about part three?
